name: Prabowo Subianto
title: President of the Republic of Indonesia
bio: President Prabowo Subianto leads the Republic of Indonesia with a transformative agenda toward Indonesia Emas 2045. A dedicated statesman and former Minister of Defense, President Prabowo champions the 8 Asta Cita strategic missions—prioritizing national food and energy self-sufficiency, free nutritious meals for 82 million schoolchildren, industrial downstreaming across 26 strategic commodities, and unwavering defense of national sovereignty.
